title: Go for the marjoram!!!
text: Carlos was wonderful. Extremely personable and knowledgeable. The drive was a little scary at some points but overall worth it, the beauty of the landscape was awe inspiring. I am going to be growing some marjoram at home after experiencing the wild marjoram on the mountainside. Such a beautiful place.
author: Jessica_B

title: If you like the mountains, you’ll love this tour!
text: We met Carlos at the designated area.& loaded in the van to  start our trip up to the mountains. En route, Carlos shared so much information with us. He’s knowledgeable about the area -plants and people. We stopped along the way for several view points and a few walks. The mountains are gorgeous! The views were stunning. When we arrived at the top, unfortunately it was cloud covered and we didn’t get the final views we hoped for. I still loved every minute of this tour. We had lunch at the ski lodge where there was a fire burning; we all warmed up around it sharing in the delight of the day. A
author: JeriJ

title: A great tour in the...
text: A great tour in the mountains that was both peaceful and full of beautiful views. Jaime was our guide, and he was a good driver, super friendly and informative, and never rushed us. The drink at the mountain hut was perfect for warming us up, just in time for the sunset. I'd definitely recommend this tour to others.
author: Uma_C

title: Mountain road trip.
text: It was a great day out with a lovely group of people. Carlos was out guide, he was very informative,lots of stops and photo opportunities. The restaurant stop at the top was good. We were taken to places we would never have explored on our own,a real highlight of our Spanish trip.
author: 461laureenj

title: Sierra Navada tour
text: Carlos was amazing a fantastic guide and so knowledgeable. The trip was stunning we cannot recommend it enough.
author: Jet29515042182

title: An excursion not to be missed
text: The landscapes of the Sierra Nevada are fabulous and the guide was extraordinary: competent, very knowledgeable and kind
author: Luc_M

title: Gorgeous Views with Little Effort
text:
Really enjoyed this tour!
Jamie's a skilled driver and had interesting insights to share about the area etc. 
The various viewpoints were gorgeous and we also saw some wild goats (ibex) and wild horses! :-)
author: lizmE9001EA

title: A fabulous experience.
text: The landscapes are fabulous and Jaime is an exceptional, competent, and very kind guide. He possesses an enormous amount of knowledge about the fauna, flora, and geology of the Sierra Nevada. It is an excursion not to be missed.
author: lucloup

title: We had a great day....
text: We had a great day. Carlos was an enthusiastic and informative guide and took us through some beautiful areas we would never have got to on our own. Highly recommended.
author: Eve_S

title: Carlos was a fantastic...
text: Carlos was a fantastic guide. He was knowledgeable and engaging. He shared his expertise on the history, culture and geography of the region. The views were stunning. A highly recommended tour.
